svg.text: OfficeMate Delivery Robot — Wiring Diagram v3 (4WD chassis)
Arduino Mega 2560 hub · 2× L298N · 4× 100 RPM gear motors · MPU6050 · INA219 · MFRC522 · 20×4 I2C LCD · HC-SR04 · IR · 2× SG90
Signal wires use net labels: connect pins that share the same bold label. Power topology at the bottom is drawn explicitly.
powered via USB from the Pi
jumper ON: onboard 5V reg self-powers logic
jumper ON: onboard 5V reg self-powers logic
same-side motors must spin the same way —
if one is reversed, swap its two motor wires
powered from buck, NOT the Mega
battery B− · both L298N GND · buck IN−/OUT− · Mega GND · all sensor GND · servo browns · Pi GND (already common through the USB cable)
